subject: Human Evolution
title: Ardi: Before Lucy
description: A micro-lesson that makes Ardi: Before Lucy usable.

hook.text: In 1994, Tim White's team found a skeleton older than Lucy—4.4 million years old—in Ethiopia's Afar region.

buildup.text: Named Ardipithecus ramidus, or 'Ardi,' she was so fragile it took 15 years to reconstruct her.

discovery.text: Ardi walked upright but also had grasping feet for climbing trees—a blend of two worlds.

twist.text: She looked nothing like a chimp, shattering the idea that our ancestor was a chimpanzee-like knuckle-walker.

climax.text: Ardi pushed the origin of bipedalism back over a million years before Lucy.
